title: BLACK BEAN SOUP
instructions: One pint of black Mexican beans, put them in five pints of water (without soaking), boil about five hours. Pass beans and liquid through a sieve, half an hour before serving; do it thoroughly, that it may be thick enough. Put it back into the pot with salt,  pepper, bunch of thyme,  onions, a quarter of lemon cut in thin slices, and a tablespoonful of butter. Have two eggs, boiled hard, cut up in your tureen, and a wineglass of good wine. Pour soup on it and give it a stir. --MRS. MORRIS ADDISON.

First cut the head in half, take out the brains, crack up the head, wash it, put it in the pot, boil half an hour. Take out, wash, clean and scrape it, put back in the pot, boil until soft, take out, pick out all the bones. Part the lean meat from the jelly meat. Cut up the jelly meat fine. Put back in the pot, thicken with flour, seasone with cloves,  black pepper,  onions and wine.  --"UNCLE JOHN"-- the best chef in South Carolina, Mr. Le Garee's and Mrs. Phoenix's cook.
